title: The invisible wall
view: six whole 256^2 worlds, 2.8 px per cell; the lower half is tinted blue (overlay only)
equivalence: FieldLenia (ex_bizarre.py) repeats alm.lenia.Lenia's step with mu, sigma as arrays or functions of the step; with uniform S001 parameters it equals Lenia bitwise over 200 steps (checked at render: True)
fate_rule: final mass > 0.5 x one Orbium's mass -> 'crosses and keeps going', else 'dies at the wall'
caveats: A sharp step in mu between neighbouring cells; the Orbium feels the other rule up to R = 13 cells before reaching the wall. One phase, one approach angle per lane.
A survivor only shows that a body with Orbium's mass persisted; it may have changed shape in the other half.
